## Core Engineering Capabilities
- **Mobile Client Engineering:** Flutter (iOS & Android), Dart, Riverpod, BLoC, Provider, Clean Architecture, MVVM, Offline-First Hive DB, Biometric device integrations, Background GPS tracking.
- **Full-Stack & Web:** Next.js (App Router, Server Components), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Web Design, English & Arabic RTL support.
- **Backend & Cloud Architecture:** Node.js, Express, Fastify, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, REST APIs, JWT authentication, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), AWS S3 file pipelines, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM).
- **Payments & DevOps:** Stripe, Urban Ledger, Tap Payments, Razorpay, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, Google Play Console release management, App Store Connect.

## Production Projects & Software
1. **Dr Plus Home Healthcare:** Production patient and doctor healthcare platform in Dubai featuring nurse bookings, doctor home visits, AWS S3 health report management, and secure payments.
2. **Dr Plus Team:** Production Flutter staff application with biometric attendance, GPS-based clock-in/out, and backend API integration. Live on Google Play Store.
3. **dirham_symbol:** Official open-source Flutter/Dart package for UAE Dirham (AED) currency symbol formatting with 160/160 Pub Points on pub.dev.
4. **Finovision:** Modern financial technology web product engineered with Next.js, React, and fluid micro-interactions.
5. **Duotek:** Corporate platform for a Dubai-based technology enterprise showcasing enterprise digital services.
6. **InterviewMind Pro:** Full-stack AI interview preparation platform generating customized interview questionnaires with automated response evaluation.
7. **QuickPitch:** Two-sided Flutter marketplace connecting service seekers with providers, featuring Google Maps geolocation, BLoC state, and Razorpay payments.
8. **InvoZoyo:** Offline-first retail POS & inventory management Flutter app engineered with Hive local database and PDF invoice generation.
